snippet.title: Achoo! What Do We Say When We Sneeze? 🤧 3 Little Duas | Islam for Kids #shorts
snippet.description:
Achoo! What do we say when we sneeze? Our beloved Prophet Muhammad (Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Alihi Wasallam) taught us three beautiful little duas:

1. When you sneeze: "Alhamdulillah" (All praise is for Allah)
2. Your friend says: "Yarhamukallah" (May Allah have mercy on you)
3. You answer: "Yahdikumullah wa yuslih balakum" (May Allah guide you and make things good for you)

Who will your little one teach this to today?

Source
• Sahih al-Bukhari 6224: https://sunnah.com/bukhari:6224
